text:
Asha Rao: Flagging a docs PR I'm putting together for Optimize: a short note on how batch_size, kv_prefetch sizing, and aggressive quant profiles (qs8/qs4) can interact and raise cache miss rates. Found this in a perf run against our internal staging fleet.

Benji Carter: Good to capture. Any reproducible snippet you can paste here so reviewers can eyeball it?

Asha Rao: Minimal Python example I'll add to the FAQ section:

```python
from redwood import OptimizeClient
client = OptimizeClient()
inputs = [{"input": f"ctx {i}"} for i in range(32)]
resp = client.generate_batch(
    model="open-qs8-v2",
    inputs=inputs,
    batch_size=16,
    use_kv_prefetch=True,
    kv_prefetch_batch_size=8,
    cache_ttl_seconds=30,
    quant_profile="qs8"
)
print(resp.metrics.cache_hits, resp.metrics.cache_misses)
```

Asha Rao: With that config we saw miss_rate jump when cache_ttl was short and batch_size >= 16. Changing kv_prefetch_batch_size down to 4 fixed the spike.

Rina Gupta: Nice. Can we add a cross-SDK example? Mobile folks asked for Kotlin last week. Keep it tiny.

Asha Rao: Yep, Kotlin draft for docs/examples: 

```kotlin
val client = OptimizeClient()
val inputs = (0 until 32).map { mapOf("input" to "ctx $it") }
client.generateBatch(
  model = "open-qs8-v2",
  inputs = inputs,
  batchSize = 16,
  useKvPrefetch = true,
  kvPrefetchBatchSize = minOf(4, 16),
  cacheTtlSeconds = 120,
  quantProfile = "qs8"
)
```

Benji Carter: That looks good. Suggest the docs include a short callout with a safe default: "kv_prefetch_batch_size = min(4, batch_size)" and a brief explanation why (eviction churn when prefetch windows overlap eviction).

Evan Miles: Also propose adding a lightweight smoke test in examples/ci that runs the repro with mocked metrics and asserts miss_rate <= 0.2. That will help catch regressions if someone changes prefetch heuristics.

Rina Gupta: +1. Add a one-paragraph non-technical explanation: low-bit kernels can change decode chunk timing which affects how much prefetched KV is still live by the time the main batch consumes it. Keep it approachable.

Asha Rao: I'll add the note, both SDK snippets, and the CI smoke test. I'll open the PR under docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1509 and tag reviewers.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1509 "optimize: kv-prefetch sizing guidance + kotlin/python examples" 1 assigned to @AshaR; reviewers @Rina @Benji.

Benji Carter: Quick nit for the PR: use cacheTtlSeconds=120 in the Kotlin example so the docs show a conservative default.

Asha Rao: Updated. Also added a Grafana query snippet to show route-level cache_hit_ratio: `sum(cache_hits) / sum(cache_hits + cache_misses)` over 5m. Included alert suggestion: fire if ratio < 0.75 for 10m.

Evan Miles: I'll wire the CI mock harness into examples/ci/mock-metrics and add the threshold check. Keeps the test lightweight and deterministic.

Rina Gupta: Added a short migration checklist bullet: "When enabling aggressive quant profiles, re-run kv-prefetch smoke tests and verify cache_hit_ratio >= 80% for representative routes."

Asha Rao: All set. Merging once reviews are in. Thanks for the quick feedback.

Asha Rao: Merged and created the follow-up. Closing out. Thanks everyone :party_parrot:
